## History

Before [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) fell ill with severe croup, young Mary Joe had never seen anyone afflicted with the condition. When [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) contracted the illness while her parents were away, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushed to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for help because Mary Joe lacked experience with it and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) was unavailable.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P24](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII.
